crew.overview: In a town in the Northwest of the province of Buenos Aires, a group of neighbors is organized to recover the economy of the area, but when the corralito is implemented in the country and they suffer a fraud, their hopes disappear. Now, they will unite to recover the lost money and give the blow of their lives to their greatest enemy.
crew.title: Heroic Losers

details.biography: Geraldina is an Argentinian editor whose work has been featured on Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, HBO, and at film festivals worldwide.
details.name: Geraldina Rodríguez
